final: WITH linked AS (SELECT s.signalregistry, s.telescref, o.weathprofile, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation), base AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS b FROM linked), grp AS (SELECT telescref, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase FROM linked GROUP BY telescref, weathprofile) SELECT g.weathprofile, AVG(g.avg_mod) AS avg_modindex, AVG(g.avg_phase) AS avg_phaseshift, AVG(g.avg_mod - base.b) AS avg_excess FROM grp g, base WHERE g.avg_mod > base.b GROUP BY g.weathprofile
